card.name: Equipment and preparation instructions in labels
card.fires_on: Small linking or auxiliary words (and, be, of, not) and syringe/vial parts in label instructions about equipment, preparation and use. Typical settings are devices "designed and", facilities "equipped and", or "do not use".
